plan_title: SSPLAN-730 Test Plan — Weekly Sales Chart has week 36 twice

results.test: Primary Weekly Sales Chart has week 36 twice render path
results.steps: Open target route with valid fixture/user context.
results.assertion: Expected primary content appears with correct title/value labels and no console/runtime error.
results.evidence: No live server was available in this run. To verify manually, open `/`, `/hfb/:id`, and `/hfb/:hfbId/pa/:paId` from frontend/src/App.tsx:33-36 and confirm the weekly chart shows each fiscal week once. Relevant source path: frontend/src/App.tsx:33-36; frontend/src/features/entity-detail/SalesIndexChart.tsx:19-23,82-83,116-123,153-158.

results.steps: Return empty dataset or no eligible rows.
results.assertion: Fallback/empty message is shown and layout remains stable (no broken placeholders).
results.evidence: The weekly chart keeps a safe empty placeholder when no data exists (frontend/src/features/entity-detail/SalesIndexChart.tsx:19-23,82-83,116-123,153-158).

results.assertion: Error state is user-visible, recoverable on retry, and does not hard-crash route.
results.evidence: Weekly metric failures are caught by callers (frontend/src/features/entity-detail/HFBDetailPage.tsx:81-107,139,171-184,207; frontend/src/features/entity-detail/PADetailPage.tsx:67-82,118,152-161,171-173), but no chart-level error UI exists.

results.steps: Run representative fixture values through transform/mapping layer.
results.assertion: Scaled and raw fields retain expected precision (sales scaled where applicable, index untouched).
results.evidence: Numeric parsing for weekly points is deterministic: rows are parsed from `sywNumber` and `netSalesTrendIndex` into chart rows (frontend/src/services/metricsApi.ts:12-14,172-215,244-257,289-297).

results.steps: Feed out-of-order and duplicate-key fixture records.
results.assertion: Output order and uniqueness follow deterministic rule (documented sort/dedupe behavior).
results.evidence: There is no dedupe rule for repeated fiscal weeks. `transformWeeklyTrendRows` sorts `latestYearRows` and maps every row directly to `weekLabel`, so duplicated `sywNumber` values would render duplicated weeks (for example, week 36 twice) (frontend/src/services/metricsApi.ts:12-14,172-215,244-257,289-297).
results.failure_reason: Weekly transform does not dedupe duplicate week labels

results.failure_reason: Weekly request contract missing country implementation
